title: Divorced co-owner needs ex to sign off
scenario: Recently divorced woman wants to refinance her ex-husband off the title and keep the house, but needs his cooperation. Rep stays careful and compliant.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Noelle? It's Ezra with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes, hi. Sorry, I'm a little frazzled today.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem at all. Is now still an okay time?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah. It's fine. It's about the house.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sure. I understand you're looking to refinance as part of a divorce?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Right. The divorce was final in September. I'm keeping the house, but both our names are on the loan.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. So the goal is to refinance into just your name?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes. But honestly, I can't do anything until my ex agrees to sign the quitclaim, and he's dragging his feet.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's really common, and it's something your attorney can help push along. Does the divorce decree say anything about the refinance timeline?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: It says within six months. I think.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's helpful. Is your income enough to carry the house on your own, do you think?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I think so. I'm a dental hygienist, full time. Plus I'm getting some support.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. Is the support documented in the decree?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes. Would that count as income?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It can, depending on how long it's set to continue and whether it's been received consistently. I'd want to review the decree before telling you how it'll be treated.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. But again, without his signature this is all kind of moot.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood. We can do all the prep on your side so you're ready the moment he signs. Would that help?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, that would actually make me feel better.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Could you send me the decree when you have a minute?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sure, I can scan it tonight.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. And let's touch base again next Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Wednesday's good.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hang in there, Noelle. Talk soon.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thank you, Ezra.
